controls.title: Identification & Authentication Policy
controls.description: The organization sets a written policy for how people and systems are identified and authenticated, and runs the access controls that put it into effect.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
controls.description: Privileged accounts, network logins and remote sessions need a second authentication factor on top of a password.

controls.title: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning
controls.description: User access is granted, changed, suspended and removed through a defined process, from a person's first day to their last.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Passwords, keys and other authenticators are issued securely, meet strength rules, are changed when needed and are kept away from anyone who should not hold them.

controls.title: Periodic Review of Individual & Service Account Privileges
controls.description: Accounts and the privileges they hold, for people and for services, are reviewed on a schedule and corrected when they no longer fit.

controls.title: Privileged Account Management (PAM)
controls.description: Privileged accounts are approved before they are created, watched while they exist and removed when the need ends.

controls.title: Emergency Accounts
controls.description: Break-glass accounts reserved for emergencies are set up and controlled in advance, monitored, and every use is reviewed afterwards.

controls.title: Asset Management Policy
controls.description: A policy and owner cover how the organization tracks and looks after its technology assets.

controls.title: Asset Inventories
controls.description: One inventory of technology assets is kept current and treated as the source everyone trusts.

controls.title: Secure Disposal, Destruction or Re-Use of Equipment
controls.description: Equipment leaving service is wiped, destroyed or securely prepared for reuse so its data cannot be recovered.

controls.title: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) Plans
controls.description: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans are written down, and each recovery role has a named owner.

controls.title: Data Backups
controls.description: Data, software and system configurations are backed up on a regular schedule.

controls.title: Testing for Reliability & Integrity
controls.description: Backups are restored in tests on a regular schedule to prove the data can actually be recovered.

controls.title: Secure Baseline Configurations
controls.description: Each technology platform has a documented, hardened baseline configuration that is kept up to date.

controls.title: Session Termination
controls.description: User sessions end on their own after a set idle period or when a defined event occurs.

controls.title: Change Management Program
controls.description: A change management program covers how changes to technology assets are requested, reviewed, approved and tracked.

controls.title: Configuration Change Control
controls.description: Configuration changes are approved before they are made and recorded so they can be traced afterwards.

controls.title: Cloud Services
controls.description: The organization decides which cloud services it uses and oversees how they are run.

controls.title: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance
controls.description: Applicable laws, regulations and contract terms are identified, and the controls needed to meet them are put in place.

controls.title: Internal Audit Function
controls.description: An internal audit function plans audits and carries them out.

controls.title: Use of Cryptographic Controls
controls.description: Cryptography is the organization's standard way to protect data, governed by policy.

controls.title: Encrypting Data At Rest
controls.description: Sensitive data stored on disks, databases and object stores is kept confidential with encryption at rest.

controls.title: Encrypting Data In Transit
controls.description: Data moving across networks is kept confidential and tamper-evident with encryption in transit.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Management
controls.description: Cryptographic keys are managed through their whole life: generation, distribution, storage, rotation and destruction.

controls.title: Cryptographic Hash
controls.description: Hashes, digital signatures or equivalent checks show that data has not been changed or destroyed without authorization.

controls.title: Integrity of Data In Transit
controls.description: Cryptographic checks reveal data that was modified while crossing a network.

controls.title: Data & Asset Classification
controls.description: Data and assets are classified by sensitivity, and each class has handling rules.

controls.title: Physically Secure All Media Containing Sensitive / Regulated Data
controls.description: Media holding sensitive or regulated data are kept under physical protection, such as locked storage or controlled areas.

controls.title: Media Transportation
controls.description: Physical and electronic media taken outside controlled areas are protected on the way, with a record of where they went and who was responsible.

controls.title: Media & Data Retention
controls.description: Retention periods are set for data and media and are enforced.

controls.title: Endpoint Protection Mechanisms
controls.description: Laptops, servers and other endpoints run protective software and settings.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection (Antimalware)
controls.description: Antimalware on endpoints finds malicious code and stops it from running.

controls.title: Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP)
controls.description: A security, compliance and resilience program with clear ownership directs the organization's security work.

controls.title: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation
controls.description: Security policies, standards and procedures are published where the people who carry them out can find them.

controls.title: Periodic Review & Update of Security, Compliance & Resilience Program
controls.description: Security policies, standards and procedures are reviewed on a set schedule and revised when the business or its environment changes.

controls.title: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities
controls.description: Security roles and responsibilities are defined and assigned to named people.

controls.title: Human Resources Security Management
controls.description: Security is part of how people are hired, managed and moved between roles.

controls.title: Rules of Behavior
controls.description: Written rules say what people may and may not do with the organization's technology, including how and where they use it.

controls.title: Personnel Sanctions
controls.description: People who break security policy face a defined disciplinary process.

controls.title: Personnel Termination
controls.description: When someone leaves, their access is removed and the organization's property is recovered.

controls.title: Incident Response Operations
controls.description: The organization runs an incident response capability that prepares for, detects, analyzes, contains, recovers from and reviews security incidents.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: Each incident is worked through a defined handling process, from the first alert through triage, containment and recovery.

controls.title: Incident Response Plan (IRP)
controls.description: A written incident response plan is kept up to date and available to everyone who has a part in it.

controls.title: Chain of Custody & Forensics
controls.description: Evidence from an incident is collected and preserved so its integrity can be shown, with a record of who held it and when.

controls.title: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Lessons Learned
controls.description: After an incident, its root cause is found and what was learned feeds back into controls and the response process.

controls.title: Incident Stakeholder Reporting
controls.description: Incidents are reported to the right stakeholders within set deadlines.

controls.title: Data Breach
controls.description: A breach of personal data is handled through a defined process, including notice to the people affected and to regulators.

controls.title: Controlled Maintenance
controls.description: Maintenance and repair of facilities and systems is approved and supervised, and a record is kept of what was repaired or changed.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Monitoring covers the whole organization, not just individual systems.

controls.title: System Generated Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
controls.description: Systems produce event logs and telemetry that show who did what and when.

controls.title: Centralized Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Review & Analysis
controls.description: Event logs and telemetry are gathered in one place and reviewed for signs of trouble.

controls.title: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Retention
controls.description: Event logs are kept for a set period chosen to meet risk and legal needs.

controls.title: Anomalous Behavior
controls.description: Behavior that departs from the normal pattern is detected and investigated.

controls.title: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM)
controls.description: File integrity monitoring catches unauthorized changes to stored data so they can be investigated.

controls.title: Network Security Controls (NSC)
controls.description: The network is protected by layered security controls such as firewalls and filtering.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Traffic crossing the network's boundaries is controlled and monitored.

controls.title: Network Segmentation (macrosegmentation)
controls.description: Systems that handle sensitive data sit in network segments kept apart from the rest.

controls.title: Wireless Networking
controls.description: Wireless networks are configured, authorized and monitored under security rules.

controls.title: Physical Access Control
controls.description: Entry to facilities is limited to authorized people.

controls.title: Data Privacy Program
controls.description: A privacy program with clear ownership governs how personal data is handled.

controls.title: Updating Personal Data (PD) Process
controls.description: Personal data is kept current, and requests to correct it are acted on.

controls.title: Personal Data (PD) Control Testing, Training & Monitoring
controls.description: Privacy controls are tested, staff are trained on them, and they are monitored to confirm they keep working.

controls.title: Authority To Collect, Process, Store & Share Personal Data (PD)
controls.description: Each use of personal data has a documented legal basis.

controls.title: Data Privacy Requirements for Contractors & Service Providers
controls.description: Contracts bind contractors and service providers to privacy obligations.

controls.title: Information Sharing With Third Parties
controls.description: Rules decide when personal data may be shared with outside parties.

controls.title: Limiting Personal Data (PD) Disclosures
controls.description: Personal data is disclosed only for approved purposes.

controls.title: Accounting of Disclosures
controls.description: A record shows which personal data was disclosed, when and to whom.

controls.title: Data Privacy Notice
controls.description: Data subjects are told in a notice how their personal data is handled.

controls.title: Data Subject Consent
controls.description: Consent from data subjects is obtained and recorded.

controls.title: Data Subject Opt-In Consent
controls.description: Where the law requires it, people opt in before their personal data is handled.

controls.title: Usage Restrictions of Personal Data (PD)
controls.description: Personal data is used only for the purposes stated when it was collected.

controls.title: Personal Data (PD) Retention & Disposal
controls.description: Personal data is kept no longer than needed and then disposed of securely.

controls.title: Personal Data (PD) Collection Methods
controls.description: Only the personal data a purpose needs is collected.

controls.title: Personal Data (PD) Accuracy & Integrity
controls.description: Personal data is kept accurate and complete.

controls.title: Data Subject Communications
controls.description: Questions and complaints from data subjects are answered.

controls.title: Data Subject Authentication
controls.description: A data subject's identity is confirmed before their request is acted on.

controls.title: Data Subject Rights Management
controls.description: Requests from data subjects to exercise their rights are received, tracked and fulfilled.

controls.title: Risk Management Program
controls.description: A risk management program identifies, rates and treats risk across the organization.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Risk assessments are carried out on a regular schedule.

controls.title: Business Impact Analysis (BIA)
controls.description: A business impact analysis ranks applications, data and processes by how much their loss or outage would hurt.

controls.title: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training
controls.description: Staff receive security, compliance and resilience awareness training.

controls.title: Secure Engineering Principles
controls.description: Systems are designed and built to recognized secure engineering principles.

controls.title: Technology Development & Acquisition
controls.description: Security requirements shape how technology is built in-house and how it is bought.

controls.title: Secure Software Development Practices (SSDP)
controls.description: Software is built under secure development practices.

controls.title: Threat Intelligence Program
controls.description: A threat intelligence program shares information across teams and uses it to shape architecture, tool choices, monitoring, threat hunting, response and recovery.

controls.title: Threat Intelligence Feeds
controls.description: Threat intelligence feeds keep the organization current on attacker tactics, techniques and procedures, and that knowledge guides preventive and compensating controls.

controls.title: Threat Catalog
controls.description: A catalog of the internal, external, natural and man-made threats that apply to the organization is kept current.

controls.title: Threat Analysis
controls.description: Threats to technology assets and business processes are identified, rated by likelihood and impact, and addressed.

controls.title: Indicators of Exposure (IOE)
controls.description: Indicators of exposure map the paths an attacker could use against the organization.

controls.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP)
controls.description: A vulnerability disclosure program takes in unsolicited reports of security flaws in the organization's products and services and feeds them into fixes.

controls.title: Threat Hunting
controls.description: Threat hunters use indicators of compromise to find and disrupt threats that existing controls missed.

controls.title: Insider Threat Program
controls.description: An insider threat program has a team drawn from several disciplines to handle insider incidents.

controls.title: Insider Threat Awareness
controls.description: Awareness training teaches staff to recognize the warning signs of an insider threat and report them.

controls.title: Third-Party Management
controls.description: A program covers how the organization selects, oversees and offboards third parties.

controls.title: Third-Party Risk Assessments & Approvals
controls.description: Each third party's risk is assessed and approved before the organization engages it.

controls.title: Third-Party Contract Requirements
controls.description: Contracts set security and privacy obligations for third parties, and those obligations flow down to their agents and subcontractors that handle the organization's data.

controls.title: Vulnerability & Patch Management Policy
controls.description: A policy and owner cover vulnerability and patch management.

controls.title: Vulnerability Remediation Process
controls.description: Vulnerabilities are found, rated, prioritized and fixed through a defined process.
